about: A web app for browsing, sharing and managing the files on a server from any browser.

prs.title: New users keep the permissions picked for them
prs.broken: When an admin created a user and ticked options like Administrator or delete rights, the user was saved without them, reset to the basic defaults.
prs.changed: The permissions chosen in the form are now kept, and defaults only fill in what was left unset.
prs.matters: Admins get the accounts they asked for, without a second trip to fix each one.

prs.title: Share uploads and deletes show up in the activity log
prs.broken: When someone used a share link to upload or delete files, the Activity Viewer showed nothing. Only renames and downloads were logged.
prs.changed: Uploads, deletes and bulk deletes made through a share are now logged under the share owner, with the share they came through.
prs.matters: Owners can see what visitors did to their files through a share, not just half of it.
